title: The mind: thinking and remembering
intro: Two pairs here trip English speakers constantly. saber and conocer both mean know (see unit 1), and recordar and acordarse both mean remember — but acordarse needs de, and recordar refuses it.

entries.note: No tengo idea is the everyday I have no idea.
tener razón is to be right. Not to have reason.

entries.warn: Not to record — that is grabar. And it takes a direct object with no preposition: recuerdo su nombre, never recuerdo de su nombre.

ex.en: I don't remember where I left it.
Remind me to call the doctor.

entries.note: Always with de: me acuerdo de ti. Same meaning as recordar, opposite grammar.
Three grammars, all correct: olvidé las llaves, me olvidé de las llaves, se me olvidaron las llaves. The last shifts the blame off you.
comprender is the slightly more formal twin.

ex.es: No entiendo nada de lo que dice.
ex.en: I don't understand a thing he says.

entries.note: aprender a + infinitive: aprender a manejar.

ex.en: She teaches maths at secondary school.

entries.note: Takes de before a clause: me di cuenta de que no estaba. Nothing to do with realizar, which means to carry out.

ex.es: No me di cuenta de la hora.

entries.note: ¿Qué te parece? asks what do you think. me parece que is I think that.

ex.es: Parece más joven de lo que es.
ex.en: She seems younger than she is.
It seems like a good idea to me.

entries.note: la decisión is the decision; tomar una decisión to make one.

ex.en: We decided to stay one more day.

entries.note: In class ¿alguna duda? means any questions.

ex.es: No hay duda de que funciona.
Tengo una duda sobre el ejercicio.
ex.en: I have a question about the exercise.

entries.note: Masculine despite the -a, like el tema, el sistema, el programa — all from Greek.
de todos modos and de todas maneras both mean anyway.

ex.es: No me gusta su manera de hablar.
ex.en: I don't like the way he talks.

entries.note: ¿verdad? at the end of a sentence is the universal tag question: isn't it, don't you, right?
equivocarse is to make a mistake; la falta is a fault or a lack.
por ejemplo is for example, abbreviated p. ej.

entries.en: to matter, to be important; to import
entries.note: Built like gustar: no me importa means it doesn't matter to me.

ex.en: It doesn't matter, we'll do it tomorrow.
They import the coffee from Colombia.

entries.note: no tiene sentido is it makes no sense. calle de un sentido is a one-way street.
